title: Excellent tick list tracker
body: I have been using everyday for over a year, and find it the best tick list tracker I’ve used, and I’ve used a lot of them.  I bought the lifelong subscription I like it so much.  It makes me feel like a winner as it tallies all my successes at the top of each page.  The color coding is motivating and the ability to schedule which days to do what and have allowed skips to keep your streak is smart as it’s dealing with real people with real lives.  It’s easy to use on my iPad, iPhone and Apple Watch.  I also can set tasks for a time period, reach my goal and archive them, which I can then reactivate again another time, which is great for seasonal habits.  The psychology behind the app of building habits to support achieving goals is well founded and works.  If you’re serious about your self-growth, this is a great app.  Since it has a free tier, it is worth giving it a go to see if it works for you.  It’s a surprisingly powerful app with a simple intuitive interface.  Thank you for creating it!

title: Exactly what I’ve been looking for
body:
After reading a lot about neuroscience, etc, I have been searching for a way to incorporate new habits into my life. 

The old adage, “practice makes perfect”, is true for all things, not just elite performances. 

I’ve added a detailed morning routine to this app including some Yoga & Pilates, and now that it’s becoming habit, I am getting through the list so much faster! 

Once I’ve got all of this programmed into my brain, I’m going to target other areas in my day to automate.

Thanks for a brilliantly simple yet powerful tool 😍
